skill_name: How does the development of artificial intelligence affect society?
workflow: The development of artificial intelligence has a significant impact on society. It has the potential to revolutionize many aspects of our world, from how we interact with technology to how we make decisions in our day-to-day lives. AI can help us better understand the world around us by providing information and insights that would otherwise be difficult or near impossible to obtain. It can also improve the efficiency of processes in a wide range of industries, making them less expensive, faster
